decisions.reason: The Cognito Sign In page already uses the landing-page background. Reusing that existing background for the Tenant Launch Flow does not change the Cognito branding requirement.
The background decision does not change the optional prototype-code deliverable, its target pages, or its task-local scope.
The policy-document format and new-tab behavior come from a separate clause already represented in this Requirement; the Tenant Launch Flow background decision does not alter policy access.
The shared shell still requires a background and header logo. Specifying the provisioning flow's particular background does not change those generic shell elements.
The source decision concerns the Tenant Launch Flow background and does not change footer content, placement, navigation links, or color.
Panel placement is discussed in a separate clause of the same message and is already represented in this Requirement. The provisioning-background modification has no effect on panel navigation.
Reusing a background from the Sign In page does not change the landing page's sections, copy plan, sequence, or sequence visual.
The landing-page design serves only as an existing background reference; the source decision does not modify the landing page's own visual direction.
The provisioning-flow background decision does not change responsive rules or breakpoint guidance.
The Tenant Launch Flow is distinct from the admin workspace shell, and the source does not change the shell's components, themes, or styling deliverable.
Using the Cognito background for one provisioning flow does not necessarily alter the shared dark theme or theme reference for website pages.
The source decision changes a provisioning-flow background and does not affect whether the landing-page header menu is enabled.
